q: Which gas is the main driver of human-caused climate change?
explain: Burning coal, oil and gas releases carbon dioxide, which traps heat in the atmosphere.

q: Which usually makes the least pollution per person on a 10 km trip?
explain: Cycling uses no fuel, and a full bus shares its emissions across many riders.

q: What happens to most food waste in a landfill?
explain: Rotting food gives off methane, a strong greenhouse gas.
